exposure: living in regions with confirmed COVID-19 cases > 500
nutrition instruction during the pandemic period
cohort: 678 women who gave birth within 7 days in maternal and children hospitals in nine cities of China from April to May 2020
finding: Maternal age > 30 years, higher pre-gestational BMI, living in regions with confirmed COVID-19 cases > 500, and excess gestational weight gain were associated with cesarean delivery in women who experienced lockdown in their third trimester during the COVID-19 pandemic.
mod_finding: The study found a high cesarean delivery rate in uninfected women who experienced lockdown in their third trimester.
